content.title: TSMC to market system to manage trade secrets, its lawyer says
content.summary: TAIPEI (Reuters) -Taiwan's TSMC manufactures the world's most advanced chips.  It now wants to teach its suppliers and partners how to better manage their trade secrets to foster innovation.  The company, the world's largest chip foundry that makes chips for the likes of Nvidia and Apple, plans to market a system it has built to manage and leverage its treasure trove of trade secrets to companies in Europe and the United States, its associate general counsel told Reuters.
